verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The OAuth gate on the hosted MCP endpoint is authentication, not credential scoping. RLS and the build-your-own-MCP pattern where tool calls run as the signed-in user are developer building blocks, and the community mention of a read-only MCP default is an adjacent control, so none of these count as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
